description: The figure presents four pie charts, each representing the distribution of categories for a specific model: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The GPT4-o chart has two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (red, 83.3%) being the largest and the other category (light orange and grey, 16.7%) being labeled with a count of 1. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart is divided into five slices: "Misinformation" (orange, 38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" (blue, 22.1%), "Ethical Advice" (yellow, 16.3%), "Clarification" (light yellow, 14.0%), and "Safety" (red, 9.3%). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (orange, 75.0%) being larger than "Clarification" (red, 25.0%). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart is also divided into two equal slices: "Lack of Knowledge" (orange, 50.0%) and "Misinformation" (red, 50.0%). All charts display percentage labels inside the slices, and the categories are distinguishable by color. The slices in each chart are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way beyond their proportional size.
